Fixed the tenant leak: cache keys now include tenant, operation, and entity ID.

Writes invalidate only that tenant’s entries. Removed the leak-related cache bypasses while preserving the internal audit tenant’s bypass.

Regression tests cover shared-cache isolation in both request orders and write invalidation. All **23 tests pass**.

Changes are local; not deployed to production.
